## RE:volution Mod v2.0.1

### Added

- No new features.

### Fixed

- Silenced the vanilla Zombie and Skeleton ambient, hurt, and death sounds for RE:volution managed mobs.
- Kept ordinary unmanaged Minecraft mobs unchanged.

### Other

- World data, Mongo schema, balance, rewards, HP, movement, appearances, and the resource pack are unchanged.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifacts published for this stable release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1
